name: @playliquid/lab-simulation
description: PlayLiquid GameOS Lab simulation/evaluation service (PL-028). The simulation/evaluation stage of the Lab loop (spec/architecture.md §Lab loop): typed evaluation-intake admission binding a candidate organization (lab-contracts dimensions) + a project-evidence bundle + evaluation parameters as one content-addressed record with typed duplicate/malformed refusals (E1); a deterministic runner (E9) that executes the candidate organization against the evidence bundle on the @playliquid/simulation machinery with @playliquid/capability-broker as the least-privilege action authority inside the simulated organization (R20) and @playliquid/replay capture so replay stays reusable by the Lab (R8); EPISTEMIC LABELING (E11, lock 28/29) enforced at the type boundary — every result record carries the labeled-estimate marker, nothing is ever observed ground truth; a typed calibration seam where immutable observations (E10, lock 27) are consumed append-only. Pure domain: the service instance is the single mutable-state owner; persistence, time, suites, evidence ledgers and observation ledgers live behind ports with deterministic in-memory fakes; no IO, no timers, no globals.
